author: Adde Engineering Desk
title_en: How to Accurately Estimate Modern Villa & Commercial Construction Costs in East Africa
title_so: Sidee Si Sax ah Loogu Qiyaasaa Kharashka Dhismaha Villa & Ganacsiga ee Bariga Afrika?
body_en: Across Mogadishu, Hargeisa, Garowe, Djibouti, and Nairobi, builds stall when investors guess costs without a measured Bill of Quantities (BOQ). Breaking down costs into Substructure (15-20%), Superstructure (25-30%), MEP (15-18%), and Finishes (30-40%) protects your capital.
body_so: Guud ahaan Muqdisho, Hargeysa, Garoowe, Jabuuti, iyo Nairobi, dhismuhu wuxuu hakadaa marka la iska qiyaaso kharashka BOQ la’aan. Kala-baxa Aasaaska, Tiirarka, Korontada & Dhammaystirka ayaa ilaaliya hantidaada.

author: Principal Architect
title_en: Passive Cooling: Designing Modern Buildings Adapted to the Horn of Africa Climate
title_so: Hawo-Wareegga Dabiiciga ah: Naqshadaynta Dhismaha La Qabsada Cimilada Geeska Afrika
body_en: Strategic orientation, deep cantilevered overhangs, perforated mashrabiya wind screens, and insulated double-leaf walls reduce indoor cooling loads by up to 40% across coastal East Africa.
body_so: Jiheynta daaqadaha, hooska dabiiciga ah, shaashadaha hawo-mareenka, iyo derbiyada kulaylka celiya waxay dhimayaan kulaylka gudaha ilaa 40%.

author: Adde Advisory
title_en: 5 Costly Mistakes Diaspora & Corporate Investors Make When Building Back Home
title_so: 5 Khalad oo Qaali ah oo Qurbo-joogta & Ganacsatadu Galaan Marka Ay Dhisme Bilaabayaan
body_en: Avoid building without soil tests, paying lump sums without milestone inspections, or skipping MEP coordination. Choose milestone-verified Design-Build transparency.
body_so: Ka fogow inaad dhisto ciidda oon la baarin, inaad lacag hal mar wada bixiso kormeer la’aan, ama naqshad aan MEP lahayn.
